articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.snippet: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

articles.title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
articles.snippet: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.snippet: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

articles.title: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
articles.snippet: Brent crude hit a five-month high while Nvidia, Meta and chip stocks fell, pulling Asia's benchmark indexes down by up to 3.5% a week after South Korea's Kospi plunged 7.57%.

articles.title: Italy Busts Mafia 'Secret Bank' That Laundered Money Through Crypto, Seizes $24M
articles.snippet: Police say a car-rental firm near Milan was an underground bank for 'Ndrangheta and Camorra figures, moving money abroad and into crypto.
